profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
I’m a seasoned software engineer focused on building large-scale distributed systems.

I currently work on the Spark team at Meta, where we power all of batch processing needs including planet-scale AI training workloads. Previously, I worked at LinkedIn on a real-time stream processing platform that supported all of LinkedIn’s real-time systems.

Data infrastructure has been a consistent focus throughout my career, including roles at GoDaddy and American Express.

Outside of my day job, I enjoy experimenting with Databases and AI Inference systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Stream Processing
positions.description:
- Key team member of LinkedIn's stream processing platform which handles 10K+ pipelines processing trillions of events per day using Apache Samza and Apache Beam.
- Led a massive cross-org migration effort of all streaming jobs from Kafka to Linkedin’s next
gen pub-sub system as a part of company-wide infra modernization initiative.
- Leading the effort to migrate job state-backup support from Kafka to LinkedIn’s S3-like blob-store which has proven to reduce job down-time across restarts by over 10x.
- Authored multiple build, tooling and user-facing control plane improvements. Some examples include- gradle plugins & repo templates for creating jobs, packaging and config publishing, job reset tool for easy job reset and drain tool for seamless schema evolution
- Created pipeline authoring APIs and language-agnostic protobuf DSLs from core features like source & sinks to complex features like batch lookups & partial writes to KV stores.
- Mentored engineers and interns to explore important initiatives like batch-stream convergence,
Beam’s tensor flow evaluation for language-agnostic pipeline authoring for LinkedIn’s ML use cases
- I am also a committer in the open source Apache Samza project:
https://samza.apache.org/community/committers.html

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built the streaming data platform at Godaddy using Apache Beam and Flink
    - Created data sources and sinks for Hive, JDBC, json data
    - Key sdks and transforms
    - Data marshalling using protobufs

• Creating the deployment infrastructure and framework using AWS. The framework-
    -  Provisions AWS services using Cloudformation templates, sceptre and boto3. 
    -  Uses helm templates to deploy dockerized applications on AWS. 
    -  The framework also enables developers to test their cloud applications on their local machines using Localstack and Docker Desktop's local k8s cluster

positions.title: Software Engineer- Intern
positions.description: Spark data pipelines for credit card fraud detection models.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Modified data pipelines by tuning existing Hive and Pig code base for crucial data marts. Migrated critical code to Spark (PySpark) leading to over 60-70% performance improvement
• Created multiple workflows and schedules using Oozie incorporating Hive/Pig/Spark actions and replacing existing Cron jobs
